title: WSH opposes summoning of injured, warns of bandh

ai.summary: Western Sümi Hoho (WSH) opposes summoning injured individuals from a November 2022 firing incident, warning of an indefinite bandh if police fail to ensure fair treatment and legal action against those responsible.

facts.claim: WSH has strongly objected to the summoning of 10 Sümi individuals injured in the November 7, 2022 firing incident
facts.quote: Western Sümi Hoho (WSH) has strongly objected to the summoning of 10 Sümi individuals injured in the November 7, 2022 firing incident at the disputed area between Kiyevi village and Lamhainamdi

facts.claim: WSH demands immediate action against those responsible for the firing
facts.quote: WSH urged the DGP to immediately review the investigation and withdraw any prejudicial action against the injured victims, ensure fair treatment and protection from arbitrary arrest or intimidation for the 10 summoned individuals, and initiate prompt legal action against all persons responsible for ordering and carrying out the firing.

facts.claim: WSH warned of an indefinite bandh if the 10 summoned individuals face arrest or unfair treatment
facts.quote: The hoho warned that if any of the 10 summoned individuals were arrested, intimidated or denied fair treatment, it would convene all Western Sümi frontal organisations and village authorities to initiate collective democratic measures, including an indefinite bandh across all Western Sümi-inhabited areas until justice was delivered.

ai.background_note: Western Sümi Hoho (WSH) is a community group in Nagaland that has been involved in protests over land disputes and alleged encroachment at Kiyevi village, leading to a November 2022 firing incident that injured 10 individuals.
